==================== frontend/src/App.jsx ====================
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate, useLocation, Outlet } from 'react-router-dom'
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './context/AuthContext'
import { HotkeysProvider } from './context/HotkeysContext'
import { AchievementsProvider } from './context/AchievementsContext'
import ThemeApplier from './context/ThemeApplier'
import AppLayout from './components/Layout/AppLayout'
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage'
import RegisterPage from './pages/RegisterPage'
import BoardsPage from './pages/BoardsPage'
import BoardDetailPage from './pages/BoardDetailPage'
import BoardSettingsPage from './pages/BoardSettingsPage'
import ProjectKanbanPage from './pages/ProjectKanbanPage'
import CalendarPage from './pages/CalendarPage'
import StatsPage from './pages/StatsPage'
import ProfilePage from './pages/ProfilePage'
import HelpPage from './pages/HelpPage'
import SettingsPage from './pages/SettingsPage'
import SearchPage from './pages/SearchPage'
import ProjectSearchPage from './pages/ProjectSearchPage'
import ShopPage from './pages/ShopPage'
import AdminShopPage from './pages/AdminShopPage'

function ProtectedRoute() {
    const { token, loading } = useAuth()
    if (loading) return <div className="loading">Загрузка...</div>
    if (!token) return <Navigate to="/login" replace />
    return <Outlet />
}

function PublicRoute() {
    const { token, loading } = useAuth()
    if (loading) return <div className="loading">Загрузка...</div>
    if (token) return <Navigate to="/" replace />
    return <Outlet />
}

function HomeRedirect() {
    const { user, loading } = useAuth()
    const location = useLocation()

    if (loading) return <div className="loading">Загрузка...</div>

    if (location.pathname !== '/') return null

    const ws = user?.workspace

    if (ws?.defaultBoardId) {
        if (ws?.launchProjectId) {
            return (
                <Navigate
                    to={`/boards/${ws.defaultBoardId}/projects/${ws.launchProjectId}`}
                    replace
                />
            )
        }
        return <Navigate to={`/boards/${ws.defaultBoardId}`} replace />
    }
    return <Navigate to="/calendar" replace />
}

export default function App() {
    return (
        <BrowserRouter>
            <AuthProvider>
                <ThemeApplier>
                    <AchievementsProvider>
                        <HotkeysProvider>
                            <Routes>
                                <Route element={<PublicRoute />}>
                                    <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
                                    <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />
                                </Route>

                                <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
                                    <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
                                        <Route path="/" element={<HomeRedirect />} />
                                        <Route path="/calendar" element={<CalendarPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/boards" element={<BoardsPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/boards/:id" element={<BoardDetailPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/boards/:boardId/settings" element={<BoardSettingsPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/boards/:boardId/projects/:projectId" element={<ProjectKanbanPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/stats" element={<StatsPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/shop" element={<ShopPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/profile" element={<ProfilePage />} />
                                        <Route path="/help" element={<HelpPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/search" element={<SearchPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/boards/:boardId/projects/:projectId/search" element={<ProjectSearchPage />} />
                                        <Route path="/admin/shop" element={<AdminShopPage />} />
                                    </Route>
                                </Route>

                                <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
                            </Routes>
                        </HotkeysProvider>
                    </AchievementsProvider>
                </ThemeApplier>
            </AuthProvider>
        </BrowserRouter>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/achievement/AchievementCard.jsx ====================
export default function AchievementCard({ achievement }) {
    const accent = `var(--accent-${achievement.accentCode || 'blue'})`
    const locked = !achievement.unlocked
    const reward = achievement.reward || 0
    const hasItem = !!achievement.rewardItemType && !!achievement.rewardItemCode

    const itemIcon = {
        ACCENT: '🎨',
        FRAME:  '🖼️',
        AVATAR: '👤',
        TREE:   '🌳',
    }[achievement.rewardItemType] || '🎁'

    const itemLabel = {
        ACCENT: 'Акцент',
        FRAME:  'Рамка',
        AVATAR: 'Аватарка',
        TREE:   'Дерево',
    }[achievement.rewardItemType] || 'Предмет'

    return (
        <div
            className={`achievement-card ${locked ? 'achievement-card--locked' : ''}`}
            style={{ '--ach-accent': accent }}
            title={achievement.description}
        >
            <div className="achievement-card__icon">
                {locked ? '🔒' : achievement.icon}
            </div>
            <div className="achievement-card__body">
                <div className="achievement-card__title">{achievement.title}</div>
                <div className="achievement-card__desc">{achievement.description}</div>

                {/* Листья */}
                {reward > 0 && (
                    <div className="achievement-card__reward">
                        Награда: 🍃 {reward}
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Предмет-награда */}
                {hasItem && (
                    <div className="achievement-card__reward achievement-card__reward--item">
                        <span className="achievement-card__reward-icon">{itemIcon}</span>
                        <span className="achievement-card__reward-label">
                            {itemLabel}
                            {achievement.rewardItemTitle && (
                                <> · <b>{achievement.rewardItemTitle}</b></>
                            )}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                )}

                {achievement.unlocked && achievement.unlockedAt && (
                    <div className="achievement-card__date">
                        Получено {new Date(achievement.unlockedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/achievement/AchievementToast.jsx ====================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export default function AchievementToast({ queue, onDismiss }) {
    const [current, setCurrent] = useState(null)

    useEffect(() => {
        if (current || !queue || queue.length === 0) return
        setCurrent(queue[0])
    }, [queue, current])

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!current) return
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            onDismiss && onDismiss(current.id)
            setCurrent(null)
        }, 6000)
        return () => clearTimeout(timer)
    }, [current, onDismiss])

    if (!current) return null

    const reward = current.reward || 0
    const hasItem = !!current.rewardItemType && !!current.rewardItemCode

    const itemIcon = {
        ACCENT: '🎨',
        FRAME:  '🖼️',
        AVATAR: '👤',
        TREE:   '🌳',
    }[current.rewardItemType] || '🎁'

    const itemLabel = {
        ACCENT: 'Акцент',
        FRAME:  'Рамка',
        AVATAR: 'Аватарка',
        TREE:   'Дерево',
    }[current.rewardItemType] || 'Предмет'

    return (
        <div className="achievement-toast">
            <div className="achievement-toast__icon">{current.icon}</div>
            <div className="achievement-toast__body">
                <div className="achievement-toast__title">Новое достижение!</div>

                {/* Название ачивки — крупно */}
                <div className="achievement-toast__name">{current.title}</div>

                {/* Описание */}
                <div className="achievement-toast__desc">{current.description}</div>

                {/* Награды */}
                {(reward > 0 || hasItem) && (
                    <div className="achievement-toast__rewards">
                        {reward > 0 && (
                            <span className="achievement-toast__reward-chip">
                                🍃 +{reward}
                            </span>
                        )}
                        {hasItem && (
                            <span className="achievement-toast__reward-chip achievement-toast__reward-chip--item">
                                {itemIcon} {itemLabel}
                                {current.rewardItemTitle && (
                                    <> · <b>{current.rewardItemTitle}</b></>
                                )}
                            </span>
                        )}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
            <button
                className="achievement-toast__close"
                onClick={() => {
                    onDismiss && onDismiss(current.id)
                    setCurrent(null)
                }}
            >×</button>
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAccentEditorModal.jsx ====================
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import Modal from '../Modal/Modal'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import { resolveUrl } from '../../utils/format'
import CategoryMultiSelect from './CategoryMultiSelect'

export default function AdminAccentEditorModal({
                                                   open, onClose, accent, categories, onSaved,
                                               }) {
    const isEdit = !!accent

    const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
    const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
    const [hexColor, setHexColor] = useState('#4c9aff')
    const [hexColorSecondary, setHexColorSecondary] = useState('#a45cd6')
    const [isGradient, setIsGradient] = useState(false)
    const [price, setPrice] = useState(0)
    const [oldPrice, setOldPrice] = useState('')
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState(0)
    const [categoryIds, setCategoryIds] = useState([])
    const [file, setFile] = useState(null)
    const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null)
    const [clearImage, setClearImage] = useState(false)
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)
    const fileInputRef = useRef(null)

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return
        if (accent) {
            setTitle(accent.title || '')
            setDescription(accent.description || '')
            setHexColor(accent.hexColor || '#4c9aff')
            setHexColorSecondary(accent.hexColorSecondary || '#a45cd6')
            setIsGradient(!!accent.isGradient)
            setPrice(accent.price || 0)
            setOldPrice(accent.oldPrice != null ? String(accent.oldPrice) : '')
            setSortOrder(accent.sortOrder || 0)
            setCategoryIds((accent.categories || []).map(c => c.id))
            setPreview(accent.imageUrl ? resolveUrl(accent.imageUrl) : null)
        } else {
            setTitle('')
            setDescription('')
            setHexColor('#4c9aff')
            setHexColorSecondary('#a45cd6')
            setIsGradient(false)
            setPrice(0)
            setOldPrice('')
            setSortOrder(0)
            setCategoryIds([])
            setPreview(null)
        }
        setFile(null)
        setClearImage(false)
        setError(null)
    }, [open, accent])

    const pickFile = (e) => {
        const f = e.target.files?.[0]
        if (!f) return
        setFile(f)
        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(f))
        setClearImage(false)
    }

    const clear = () => {
        setFile(null)
        setPreview(null)
        setClearImage(true)
    }

    const submit = async () => {
        if (!title.trim()) {
            setError('Укажи название')
            return
        }
        setSaving(true)
        setError(null)
        try {
            const fd = new FormData()
            fd.append('title', title.trim())
            fd.append('description', description.trim())
            fd.append('hexColor', hexColor)
            if (isGradient && hexColorSecondary) {
                fd.append('hexColorSecondary', hexColorSecondary)
            }
            fd.append('isGradient', isGradient ? 'true' : 'false')
            fd.append('price', String(Number(price) || 0))
            if (oldPrice !== '') fd.append('oldPrice', String(Number(oldPrice) || 0))
            fd.append('sortOrder', String(Number(sortOrder) || 0))
            categoryIds.forEach(id => fd.append('categoryIds', String(id)))
            if (file) fd.append('file', file)
            if (clearImage) fd.append('clearImage', 'true')

            if (isEdit) {
                await adminApi.updateAccent(accent.id, fd)
            } else {
                await adminApi.createAccent(fd)
            }
            onSaved && onSaved()
            onClose()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка сохранения')
        } finally {
            setSaving(false)
        }
    }

    const remove = async () => {
        if (!accent) return
        if (!confirm(`Удалить акцент «${accent.title}»?`)) return
        setSaving(true)
        try {
            await adminApi.deleteAccent(accent.id)
            onSaved && onSaved()
            onClose()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка удаления')
        } finally {
            setSaving(false)
        }
    }

    const previewStyle = isGradient
        ? {
            backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${hexColor} 0%, ${hexColorSecondary} 100%)`,
            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
        }
        : { backgroundColor: hexColor, backgroundImage: 'none' }

    return (
        <Modal
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={isEdit ? `Редактировать: ${accent.title}` : 'Новый акцент'}
            footer={
                <>
                    {isEdit && (
                        <button className="btn btn-icon btn-icon--danger" onClick={remove} disabled={saving}>🗑</button>
                    )}
                    <div className="modal__foot-spacer" />
                    <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Отмена</button>
                    <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={submit} disabled={saving || !title.trim()}>
                        {saving ? 'Сохранение...' : 'Сохранить'}
                    </button>
                </>
            }
        >
            <div className="admin-avatar-editor">
                <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview">
                    {preview ? (
                        <img src={preview} alt="" style={{ borderRadius: 12 }} />
                    ) : (
                        <div
                            style={{
                                width: 200,
                                height: 200,
                                borderRadius: '50%',
                                boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
                                backgroundSize: '100% 100%',
                                backgroundRepeat: 'no-repeat',
                                ...previewStyle,
                            }}
                        />
                    )}

                    <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview-actions">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn btn-ghost"
                            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                        >
                            {preview ? 'Заменить фото' : 'Загрузить фото (опц.)'}
                        </button>
                        {preview && (
                            <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={clear}>
                                Убрать
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <input
                        ref={fileInputRef}
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        style={{ display: 'none' }}
                        onChange={pickFile}
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="admin-avatar-editor__fields">
                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Название</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            value={title}
                            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                            maxLength={120}
                            autoFocus
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Основной цвет</label>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                            <input
                                type="color"
                                value={hexColor}
                                onChange={(e) => setHexColor(e.target.value)}
                                style={{
                                    width: 60,
                                    height: 40,
                                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                    borderRadius: 6,
                                    background: 'transparent',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    padding: 0,
                                }}

                                className="input"
                                value={hexColor}
                                onChange={(e) => setHexColor(e.target.value)}
                                maxLength={9}
                                style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}
                            />

                    </div>

                    <label className="task-detail__toggle">
                        <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={isGradient}
                            onChange={(e) => setIsGradient(e.target.checked)}
                        />
                        <span>Это градиент (второй цвет)</span>
                    </label>

                    {isGradient && (
                        <div className="modal__field">
                            <label className="modal__label">Второй цвет (конец градиента)</label>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                                <input
                                    type="color"
                                    value={hexColorSecondary}
                                    onChange={(e) => setHexColorSecondary(e.target.value)}
                                    style={{
                                        width: 60,
                                        height: 40,
                                        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                        borderRadius: 6,

                                        cursor: 'pointer',

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAccentsList.jsx ====================
import { useState } from 'react'
import AccentCard from '../Shop/AccentCard'
import AdminAccentEditorModal from './AdminAccentEditorModal'
import SortArrows from './SortArrows'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import { getSwapPair, computeNewOrders } from '../../utils/adminSort'

export default function AdminAccentsList({ accents, categories, onReload }) {
    const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(false)
    const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null)
    const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null)

    const openCreate = () => { setEditing(null); setEditorOpen(true) }
    const openEdit = (a) => { setEditing(a); setEditorOpen(true) }

    const move = async (index, delta) => {
        const pair = getSwapPair(accents, index, delta)
        if (!pair) return
        const [current, neighbor] = pair
        const { currentNew, neighborNew } = computeNewOrders(current, neighbor)

        setBusyId(current.id)
        try {
            const fd1 = new FormData()
            fd1.append('sortOrder', String(currentNew))
            const fd2 = new FormData()
            fd2.append('sortOrder', String(neighborNew))

            await Promise.all([
                adminApi.updateAccent(current.id, fd1),
                adminApi.updateAccent(neighbor.id, fd2),
            ])
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            alert(err.response?.data?.message || 'Не удалось переместить')
        } finally {
            setBusyId(null)
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="admin-section">
            <div className="admin-section__head">
                <h3 className="admin-section__title">Акценты ({accents.length})</h3>
                <button className="btn btn-primary admin-section__add-btn" onClick={openCreate}>
                    + Создать акцент
                </button>
            </div>

            <div className="shop__grid">
                {accents.map((a, index) => (
                    <div key={a.id} className="admin-shop-card-wrap">
                        <AccentCard
                            item={a}
                            onBuy={() => {}}
                            onEquip={() => {}}
                            onUnequip={() => {}}
                        />
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            className="admin-shop-card-edit"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                openEdit(a)
                            }}
                            title="Редактировать"
                        >✎</button>
                        <SortArrows
                            onUp={() => move(index, -1)}
                            onDown={() => move(index, +1)}
                            canUp={index > 0}
                            canDown={index < accents.length - 1}
                            loading={busyId === a.id}
                        />
                    </div>
                ))}

                {accents.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="admin-empty" style={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1' }}>Пока нет акцентов</div>
                )}
            </div>

            <AdminAccentEditorModal
                open={editorOpen}
                onClose={() => { setEditorOpen(false); setEditing(null) }}
                accent={editing}
                categories={categories}
                onSaved={onReload}
            />
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAccentTab.jsx ====================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import AdminCategoriesEditor from './AdminCategoriesEditor'
import AdminAccentsList from './AdminAccentsList'

export default function AdminAccentTab() {
    const [categories, setCategories] = useState([])
    const [accents, setAccents] = useState([])
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)

    const load = async () => {
        setLoading(true)
        setError(null)
        try {
            const [c, a] = await Promise.all([
                adminApi.listAccentCategories(),
                adminApi.listAccents(),
            ])
            setCategories(c.data)
            setAccents(a.data)
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка загрузки')
        } finally {
            setLoading(false)
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => { load() }, [])

    return (
        <div className="admin-avatar-tab">
            {error && <div className="profile-msg profile-msg--error">{error}</div>}
            {loading && <div className="loading">Загрузка...</div>}

            {!loading && (
                <>
                    <AdminCategoriesEditor
                        title="Типы акцентов"
                        categories={categories}
                        countKey={null}
                        onCreate={(dto) => adminApi.createAccentCategory(dto)}
                        onUpdate={(id, dto) => adminApi.updateAccentCategory(id, dto)}
                        onDelete={(id) => adminApi.deleteAccentCategory(id)}
                        onReload={load}
                    />

                    <AdminAccentsList
                        accents={accents}
                        categories={categories}
                        onReload={load}
                    />
                </>
            )}
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAvatarCategories.jsx ====================
import { useState } from 'react'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'

export default function AdminAvatarCategories({ categories, onReload }) {
    const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null)   // { id, title, sortOrder }
    const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false)
    const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('')
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)

    const startEdit = (c) => {
        setEditing({ id: c.id, title: c.title, sortOrder: c.sortOrder })
        setError(null)
    }

    const saveEdit = async () => {
        if (!editing.title.trim()) return
        try {
            await adminApi.updateAvatarCategory(editing.id, {
                title: editing.title.trim(),
                sortOrder: Number(editing.sortOrder),
            })
            setEditing(null)
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка')
        }
    }

    const remove = async (c) => {
        if (!confirm(`Удалить тип «${c.title}»? Аватарки останутся, но без типа.`)) return
        try {
            await adminApi.deleteAvatarCategory(c.id)
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка')
        }
    }

    const create = async () => {
        if (!newTitle.trim()) return
        try {
            await adminApi.createAvatarCategory({
                title: newTitle.trim(),
                sortOrder: (categories.length + 1) * 10,
            })
            setNewTitle('')
            setCreating(false)
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка')
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="admin-section">
            <div className="admin-section__head">
                <h3 className="admin-section__title">Типы аватарок</h3>
                <button className="btn btn-ghost admin-section__add-btn" onClick={() => setCreating(true)}>
                    + Добавить тип
                </button>
            </div>

            {error && <div className="profile-msg profile-msg--error">{error}</div>}

            <div className="admin-categories-list">
                {categories.map(c => (
                    editing?.id === c.id ? (
                        <div key={c.id} className="admin-category-row admin-category-row--editing">
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                value={editing.title}
                                onChange={(e) => setEditing(f => ({ ...f, title: e.target.value }))}
                                autoFocus
                            />
                            <input
                                className="input admin-category-row__order"
                                type="number"
                                value={editing.sortOrder}
                                onChange={(e) => setEditing(f => ({ ...f, sortOrder: e.target.value }))}
                            />
                            <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={saveEdit}>ОК</button>
                            <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>×</button>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div key={c.id} className="admin-category-row">
                            <span className="admin-category-row__title">{c.title}</span>
                            <span className="admin-category-row__code">{c.code}</span>
                            <span className="admin-category-row__count">{c.avatarCount} шт.</span>
                            <button className="admin-category-row__btn" onClick={() => startEdit(c)} title="Изменить">✎</button>
                            <button className="admin-category-row__btn admin-category-row__btn--danger" onClick={() => remove(c)} title="Удалить">🗑</button>
                        </div>
                    )
                ))}

                {creating && (
                    <div className="admin-category-row admin-category-row--editing">
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            placeholder="Название типа (напр. Аниме)"
                            value={newTitle}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && create()}
                            autoFocus
                        />
                        <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={create}>Создать</button>
                        <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>×</button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {categories.length === 0 && !creating && (
                    <div className="admin-empty">Пока нет типов</div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAvatarEditorModal.jsx ====================
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import Modal from '../Modal/Modal'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import { resolveUrl } from '../../utils/format'
import CategoryMultiSelect from './CategoryMultiSelect'

export default function AdminAvatarEditorModal({
                                                   open, onClose, avatar, categories, onSaved,
                                               }) {
    const isEdit = !!avatar

    const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
    const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
    const [emoji, setEmoji] = useState('')
    const [price, setPrice] = useState(0)
    const [oldPrice, setOldPrice] = useState('')
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState(0)
    const [categoryIds, setCategoryIds] = useState([])
    const [file, setFile] = useState(null)
    const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null)
    const [clearImage, setClearImage] = useState(false)
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)
    const fileInputRef = useRef(null)

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return
        if (avatar) {
            setTitle(avatar.title || '')
            setDescription(avatar.description || '')
            setEmoji(avatar.emoji || '')
            setPrice(avatar.price || 0)
            setOldPrice(avatar.oldPrice != null ? String(avatar.oldPrice) : '')
            setSortOrder(avatar.sortOrder || 0)
            setCategoryIds((avatar.categories || []).map(c => c.id))
            setPreview(avatar.imageUrl ? resolveUrl(avatar.imageUrl) : null)
        } else {
            setTitle('')
            setDescription('')
            setEmoji('')
            setPrice(0)
            setOldPrice('')
            setSortOrder(0)
            setCategoryIds([])
            setPreview(null)
        }
        setFile(null)
        setClearImage(false)
        setError(null)
    }, [open, avatar])

    const pickFile = (e) => {
        const f = e.target.files?.[0]
        if (!f) return
        setFile(f)
        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(f))
        setClearImage(false)
    }

    const clear = () => {
        setFile(null)
        setPreview(null)
        setClearImage(true)
    }

    const submit = async () => {
        if (!title.trim()) {
            setError('Укажи название')
            return
        }
        setSaving(true)
        setError(null)
        try {
            const fd = new FormData()
            fd.append('title', title.trim())
            fd.append('description', description.trim())
            fd.append('emoji', emoji.trim())
            fd.append('price', String(Number(price) || 0))
            if (oldPrice !== '') fd.append('oldPrice', String(Number(oldPrice) || 0))
            fd.append('sortOrder', String(Number(sortOrder) || 0))
            categoryIds.forEach(id => fd.append('categoryIds', String(id)))
            if (file) fd.append('file', file)
            if (clearImage) fd.append('clearImage', 'true')

            if (isEdit) {
                await adminApi.updateAvatar(avatar.id, fd)
            } else {
                await adminApi.createAvatar(fd)
            }
            onSaved && onSaved()
            onClose()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка сохранения')
        } finally {
            setSaving(false)
        }
    }

    const remove = async () => {
        if (!avatar) return
        if (!confirm(`Удалить аватарку «${avatar.title}»?`)) return
        setSaving(true)
        try {
            await adminApi.deleteAvatar(avatar.id)
            onSaved && onSaved()
            onClose()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка удаления')
        } finally {
            setSaving(false)
        }
    }

    return (
        <Modal
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={isEdit ? `Редактировать: ${avatar.title}` : 'Новая аватарка'}
            footer={
                <>
                    {isEdit && (
                        <button className="btn btn-icon btn-icon--danger" onClick={remove} disabled={saving}>
                            🗑
                        </button>
                    )}
                    <div className="modal__foot-spacer" />
                    <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Отмена</button>
                    <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={submit} disabled={saving || !title.trim()}>
                        {saving ? 'Сохранение...' : 'Сохранить'}
                    </button>
                </>
            }
        >
            <div className="admin-avatar-editor">
                <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview">
                    {preview ? (
                        <img src={preview} alt="" />
                    ) : (
                        <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview-empty">нет фото</div>
                    )}
                    <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview-actions">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn btn-ghost"
                            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                        >
                            {preview ? 'Заменить' : 'Загрузить фото'}
                        </button>
                        {preview && (
                            <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={clear}>
                                Убрать
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <input
                        ref={fileInputRef}
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        style={{ display: 'none' }}
                        onChange={pickFile}
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="admin-avatar-editor__fields">
                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Название</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            value={title}
                            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                            maxLength={120}
                            autoFocus
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__row modal__row--price">
                        <div className="modal__field">
                            <label className="modal__label">
                                Обычная цена
                                <span className="modal__label-hint">зачёркнутая, если есть скидка</span>
                            </label>
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                value={oldPrice}
                                onChange={(e) => setOldPrice(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="напр. 200"
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="modal__field">
                            <label className="modal__label">
                                Цена со скидкой
                                <span className="modal__label-hint">актуальная</span>
                            </label>
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                value={price}
                                onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="напр. 100"
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Порядок сортировки</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            type="number"
                            value={sortOrder}
                            onChange={(e) => setSortOrder(e.target.value)}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Типы (можно выбрать несколько)</label>
                        <CategoryMultiSelect
                            categories={categories}
                            selectedIds={categoryIds}
                            onChange={setCategoryIds}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Эмодзи (если это эмодзи-аватарка)</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            value={emoji}
                            onChange={(e) => setEmoji(e.target.value)}
                            maxLength={8}
                            placeholder="напр. 🐱"
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Описание</label>
                        <textarea
                            className="input"
                            value={description}
                            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                            maxLength={500}
                            rows={3}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {error && <div className="modal__error">{error}</div>}
                </div>
            </div>
        </Modal>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAvatarTab.jsx ====================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import AdminAvatarCategories from './AdminAvatarCategories'
import AdminAvatarsList from './AdminAvatarsList'

export default function AdminAvatarTab() {
    const [categories, setCategories] = useState([])
    const [avatars, setAvatars] = useState([])
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)

    const load = async () => {
        setLoading(true)
        setError(null)
        try {
            const [c, a] = await Promise.all([
                adminApi.listAvatarCategories(),
                adminApi.listAvatars(),
            ])
            setCategories(c.data)
            setAvatars(a.data)
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка загрузки')
        } finally {
            setLoading(false)
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => { load() }, [])

    return (
        <div className="admin-avatar-tab">
            {error && <div className="profile-msg profile-msg--error">{error}</div>}

            <AdminAvatarCategories
                categories={categories}
                onReload={load}
            />

            <AdminAvatarsList
                avatars={avatars}
                categories={categories}
                onReload={load}
            />
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminCategoriesEditor.jsx ====================
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function AdminCategoriesEditor({
                                                  title,
                                                  categories,
                                                  onCreate,
                                                  onUpdate,
                                                  onDelete,
                                                  onReload,
                                                  countKey = 'avatarCount',
                                              }) {
    const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null)
    const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false)
    const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('')
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)

    const startEdit = (c) => {
        setEditing({ id: c.id, title: c.title, sortOrder: c.sortOrder })
        setError(null)
    }

    const saveEdit = async () => {
        if (!editing.title.trim()) return
        try {
            await onUpdate(editing.id, {
                title: editing.title.trim(),
                sortOrder: Number(editing.sortOrder),
            })
            setEditing(null)
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка')
        }
    }

    const remove = async (c) => {
        if (!confirm(`Удалить тип «${c.title}»? Элементы останутся, но без типа.`)) return
        try {
            await onDelete(c.id)
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка')
        }
    }

    const create = async () => {
        if (!newTitle.trim()) return
        try {
            await onCreate({
                title: newTitle.trim(),
                sortOrder: (categories.length + 1) * 10,
            })
            setNewTitle('')
            setCreating(false)
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка')
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="admin-section">
            <div className="admin-section__head">
                <h3 className="admin-section__title">{title}</h3>
                <button
                    className="btn btn-ghost admin-section__add-btn"
                    onClick={() => setCreating(true)}
                >
                    + Добавить тип
                </button>
            </div>

            {error && <div className="profile-msg profile-msg--error">{error}</div>}

            <div className="admin-categories-list">
                {categories.map(c => (
                    editing?.id === c.id ? (
                        <div key={c.id} className="admin-category-row admin-category-row--editing">
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                value={editing.title}
                                onChange={(e) => setEditing(f => ({ ...f, title: e.target.value }))}
                                autoFocus
                            />
                            <input
                                className="input admin-category-row__order"
                                type="number"
                                value={editing.sortOrder}
                                onChange={(e) => setEditing(f => ({ ...f, sortOrder: e.target.value }))}
                            />
                            <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={saveEdit}>ОК</button>
                            <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>×</button>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <div key={c.id} className="admin-category-row">
                            <span className="admin-category-row__title">{c.title}</span>
                            {countKey && c[countKey] != null && (
                                <span className="admin-category-row__count">{c[countKey]} шт.</span>
                            )}
                            <button
                                className="admin-category-row__btn"
                                onClick={() => startEdit(c)}
                                title="Изменить"
                            >✎</button>
                            <button
                                className="admin-category-row__btn admin-category-row__btn--danger"
                                onClick={() => remove(c)}
                                title="Удалить"
                            >🗑</button>
                        </div>
                    )
                ))}

                {creating && (
                    <div className="admin-category-row admin-category-row--editing">
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            placeholder="Название типа"
                            value={newTitle}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && create()}
                            autoFocus
                        />
                        <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={create}>Создать</button>
                        <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={() => setCreating(false)}>×</button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {categories.length === 0 && !creating && (
                    <div className="admin-empty">Пока нет типов</div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminFrameEditorModal.jsx ====================
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import Modal from '../Modal/Modal'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import { resolveUrl } from '../../utils/format'
import CategoryMultiSelect from './CategoryMultiSelect'

export default function AdminFrameEditorModal({
                                                  open, onClose, frame, categories, onSaved,
                                              }) {
    const isEdit = !!frame

    const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
    const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
    const [cssClass, setCssClass] = useState('')
    const [hexColor, setHexColor] = useState('#4c9aff')
    const [price, setPrice] = useState(0)
    const [oldPrice, setOldPrice] = useState('')
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState(0)
    const [categoryIds, setCategoryIds] = useState([])
    const [file, setFile] = useState(null)
    const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null)
    const [clearImage, setClearImage] = useState(false)
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
    const [error, setError] = useState(null)
    const fileInputRef = useRef(null)

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return
        if (frame) {
            setTitle(frame.title || '')
            setDescription(frame.description || '')
            setCssClass(frame.cssClass || '')
            setHexColor(frame.hexColor || '#4c9aff')
            setPrice(frame.price || 0)
            setOldPrice(frame.oldPrice != null ? String(frame.oldPrice) : '')
            setSortOrder(frame.sortOrder || 0)
            setCategoryIds((frame.categories || []).map(c => c.id))
            setPreview(frame.imageUrl ? resolveUrl(frame.imageUrl) : null)
        } else {
            setTitle('')
            setDescription('')
            setCssClass('')
            setHexColor('#4c9aff')
            setPrice(0)
            setOldPrice('')
            setSortOrder(0)
            setCategoryIds([])
            setPreview(null)
        }
        setFile(null)
        setClearImage(false)
        setError(null)
    }, [open, frame])

    const pickFile = (e) => {
        const f = e.target.files?.[0]
        if (!f) return
        setFile(f)
        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(f))
        setClearImage(false)
    }

    const clear = () => {
        setFile(null)
        setPreview(null)
        setClearImage(true)
    }

    const submit = async () => {
        if (!title.trim()) {
            setError('Укажи название')
            return
        }
        setSaving(true)
        setError(null)
        try {
            const fd = new FormData()
            fd.append('title', title.trim())
            fd.append('description', description.trim())
            if (cssClass.trim()) fd.append('cssClass', cssClass.trim())
            if (hexColor) fd.append('hexColor', hexColor)
            fd.append('price', String(Number(price) || 0))
            if (oldPrice !== '') fd.append('oldPrice', String(Number(oldPrice) || 0))
            fd.append('sortOrder', String(Number(sortOrder) || 0))
            categoryIds.forEach(id => fd.append('categoryIds', String(id)))
            if (file) fd.append('file', file)
            if (clearImage) fd.append('clearImage', 'true')

            if (isEdit) {
                await adminApi.updateFrame(frame.id, fd)
            } else {
                await adminApi.createFrame(fd)
            }
            onSaved && onSaved()
            onClose()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка сохранения')
        } finally {
            setSaving(false)
        }
    }

    const remove = async () => {
        if (!frame) return
        if (!confirm(`Удалить рамку «${frame.title}»?`)) return
        setSaving(true)
        try {
            await adminApi.deleteFrame(frame.id)
            onSaved && onSaved()
            onClose()
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Ошибка удаления')
        } finally {
            setSaving(false)
        }
    }

    return (
        <Modal
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={isEdit ? `Редактировать: ${frame.title}` : 'Новая рамка'}
            footer={
                <>
                    {isEdit && (
                        <button className="btn btn-icon btn-icon--danger" onClick={remove} disabled={saving}>🗑</button>
                    )}
                    <div className="modal__foot-spacer" />
                    <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>Отмена</button>
                    <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={submit} disabled={saving || !title.trim()}>
                        {saving ? 'Сохранение...' : 'Сохранить'}
                    </button>
                </>
            }
        >
            <div className="admin-avatar-editor">
                <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview">
                    {preview ? (
                        <img src={preview} alt="" style={{ borderRadius: 12 }} />
                    ) : (
                        <div
                            className={`avatar-frame ${cssClass || ''}`}
                            style={{ width: 200, height: 200 }}
                        >
                            <div className="avatar-frame__inner">
                                <span className="avatar-frame__initial" style={{ fontSize: 80 }}>Т</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="admin-avatar-editor__preview-actions">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn btn-ghost"
                            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                        >
                            {preview ? 'Заменить фото' : 'Загрузить фото'}
                        </button>
                        {preview && (
                            <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={clear}>
                                Убрать
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <input
                        ref={fileInputRef}
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        style={{ display: 'none' }}
                        onChange={pickFile}
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="admin-avatar-editor__fields">
                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Название</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            value={title}
                            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                            maxLength={120}
                            autoFocus
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">CSS-класс (frame--gold и т.п.)</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            value={cssClass}
                            onChange={(e) => setCssClass(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="frame--gold"
                            maxLength={64}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Цвет (если нет картинки)</label>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                            <input
                                type="color"
                                value={hexColor}
                                onChange={(e) => setHexColor(e.target.value)}
                                style={{
                                    width: 60,
                                    height: 40,
                                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                                    borderRadius: 6,
                                    background: 'transparent',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    padding: 0,
                                }}
                            />
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                value={hexColor}
                                onChange={(e) => setHexColor(e.target.value)}
                                maxLength={9}
                                style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__row modal__row--price">
                        <div className="modal__field">
                            <label className="modal__label">
                                Обычная цена
                                <span className="modal__label-hint">зачёркнутая, если есть скидка</span>
                            </label>
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                value={oldPrice}
                                onChange={(e) => setOldPrice(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="напр. 500"
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="modal__field">
                            <label className="modal__label">
                                Цена со скидкой
                                <span className="modal__label-hint">актуальная</span>
                            </label>
                            <input
                                className="input"
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                value={price}
                                onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="напр. 300"
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Порядок сортировки</label>
                        <input
                            className="input"
                            type="number"
                            value={sortOrder}
                            onChange={(e) => setSortOrder(e.target.value)}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Типы (можно выбрать несколько)</label>
                        <CategoryMultiSelect
                            categories={categories}
                            selectedIds={categoryIds}
                            onChange={setCategoryIds}
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="modal__field">
                        <label className="modal__label">Описание</label>
                        <textarea
                            className="input"
                            value={description}
                            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                            maxLength={500}
                            rows={3}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {error && <div className="modal__error">{error}</div>}
                </div>
            </div>
        </Modal>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/AdminFramesList.jsx ====================
import { useState } from 'react'
import FrameCard from '../Shop/FrameCard'
import AdminFrameEditorModal from './AdminFrameEditorModal'
import SortArrows from './SortArrows'
import { adminApi } from '../../api/api'
import { getSwapPair, computeNewOrders } from '../../utils/adminSort'

export default function AdminFramesList({ frames, categories, onReload }) {
    const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(false)
    const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null)
    const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null)

    const openCreate = () => { setEditing(null); setEditorOpen(true) }
    const openEdit = (f) => { setEditing(f); setEditorOpen(true) }

    const move = async (index, delta) => {
        const pair = getSwapPair(frames, index, delta)
        if (!pair) return
        const [current, neighbor] = pair
        const { currentNew, neighborNew } = computeNewOrders(current, neighbor)

        setBusyId(current.id)
        try {
            const fd1 = new FormData()
            fd1.append('sortOrder', String(currentNew))
            const fd2 = new FormData()
            fd2.append('sortOrder', String(neighborNew))

            await Promise.all([
                adminApi.updateFrame(current.id, fd1),
                adminApi.updateFrame(neighbor.id, fd2),
            ])
            onReload()
        } catch (err) {
            alert(err.response?.data?.message || 'Не удалось переместить')
        } finally {
            setBusyId(null)
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="admin-section">
            <div className="admin-section__head">
                <h3 className="admin-section__title">Рамки ({frames.length})</h3>
                <button className="btn btn-primary admin-section__add-btn" onClick={openCreate}>
                    + Создать рамку
                </button>
            </div>

            <div className="shop__grid">
                {frames.map((f, index) => (
                    <div key={f.id} className="admin-shop-card-wrap">
                        <FrameCard
                            item={f}
                            onBuy={() => {}}
                            onEquip={() => {}}
                            onUnequip={() => {}}
                        />
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            className="admin-shop-card-edit"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                openEdit(f)
                            }}
                            title="Редактировать"
                        >✎</button>
                        <SortArrows
                            onUp={() => move(index, -1)}
                            onDown={() => move(index, +1)}
                            canUp={index > 0}
                            canDown={index < frames.length - 1}
                            loading={busyId === f.id}
                        />
                    </div>
                ))}

                {frames.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="admin-empty" style={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1' }}>Пока нет рамок</div>
                )}
            </div>

            <AdminFrameEditorModal
                open={editorOpen}
                onClose={() => { setEditorOpen(false); setEditing(null) }}
                frame={editing}
                categories={categories}
                onSaved={onReload}
            />
        </div>
    )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

==================== frontend/src/components/admin/CategoryMultiSelect.jsx ====================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

export default function CategoryMultiSelect({ categories, selectedIds = [], onChange, placeholder = 'Выбрать типы...' }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
    const ref = useRef(null)

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return
        const onClick = (e) => {
            if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false)
        }
        window.addEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
        return () => window.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
    }, [open])

    const toggle = (id) => {
        const has = selectedIds.includes(id)
        const next = has ? selectedIds.filter(x => x !== id) : [...selectedIds, id]
        onChange(next)
    }

    const selectedTitles = categories
        .filter(c => selectedIds.includes(c.id))
        .map(c => c.title)

    const displayText = selectedTitles.length === 0
        ? placeholder
        : selectedTitles.join(', ')

    return (
        <div className="cat-ms" ref={ref}>
            <button
                type="button"
                className={`cat-ms__trigger ${open ? 'cat-ms__trigger--open' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)}
            >
                <span className={`cat-ms__trigger-text ${selectedTitles.length === 0 ? 'cat-ms__trigger-text--placeholder' : ''}`}>
                    {displayText}
                </span>
                <span className="cat-ms__trigger-caret">{open ? '▴' : '▾'}</span>
            </button>

            {open && (
                <div className="cat-ms__dropdown">
                    {categories.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="cat-ms__empty">Нет типов</div>
                    ) : (
                        categories.map(c => {
                            const active = selectedIds.includes(c.id)
                            return (
                                <label key={c.id} className="cat-ms__item">
                                    <input
                                        type="checkbox"
                                        checked={active}
                                        onChange={() => toggle(c.id)}
                                    />
                                    <span className="cat-ms__item-title">{c.title}</span>
                                </label>
                            )
                        })
                    )}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    )
}
