==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/BanyanTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Круглый лист баньяна
function BanyanLeaf({ cx, cy, r = 3, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#7ab342', vein: '#4a8a24', edge: '#3a7520' },
        mid:   { fill: '#4e8a24', vein: '#2f6b22', edge: '#1f5a18' },
        deep:  { fill: '#3a6e18', vein: '#1f4a10', edge: '#163808' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy} rx={r * 0.7} ry={r * 1.1}
                     fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={r * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r * 0.9} x2={cx} y2={cy + r * 0.9}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={r * 0.09} opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function BanyanCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 9, count = 14, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <BanyanLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                        r={2.8 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1.1}
                        rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                        tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Воздушный корень — волнистая тонкая линия с утолщением
function AerialRoot({ x1, y1, x2, y2, seed = 0 }) {
    const midX = (x1 + x2) / 2 + (seededRandom(seed, 0) - 0.5) * 4
    const midY = (y1 + y2) / 2
    return (
        <g>
            <path d={`M${x1} ${y1} Q${midX} ${midY} ${x2} ${y2}`}
                  stroke="#5c3a1e" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d={`M${x1} ${y1} Q${midX} ${midY} ${x2} ${y2}`}
                  stroke="#7a5233" strokeWidth="0.5" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Воздушные корни — главная фишка
function AerialRoots({ topY = 16 }) {
    const roots = []
    // От разных точек веток — вниз к земле
    const rootData = [
        // Левая сторона
        { x: 24, y: topY - 4, seed: 1 },
        { x: 14, y: topY + 8, seed: 2 },
        { x: 4, y: topY + 14, seed: 3 },
        { x: 20, y: topY + 20, seed: 4 },
        { x: 8, y: topY + 30, seed: 5 },
        { x: 0, y: topY + 20, seed: 6 },

        // Центр
        { x: 40, y: topY - 8, seed: 7 },
        { x: 60, y: topY - 8, seed: 8 },
        { x: 34, y: topY - 12, seed: 9 },
        { x: 66, y: topY - 12, seed: 10 },

        // Правая сторона
        { x: 76, y: topY - 4, seed: 11 },
        { x: 86, y: topY + 8, seed: 12 },
        { x: 96, y: topY + 14, seed: 13 },
        { x: 80, y: topY + 20, seed: 14 },
        { x: 92, y: topY + 30, seed: 15 },
        { x: 100, y: topY + 20, seed: 16 },
    ]

    for (const r of rootData) {
        // Каждый корень свисает до земли ~95
        const endY = 95 - seededRandom(r.seed, 100) * 3
        roots.push(
            <AerialRoot key={r.seed}
                        x1={r.x} y1={r.y}
                        x2={r.x + (seededRandom(r.seed, 50) - 0.5) * 3} y2={endY}
                        seed={r.seed}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{roots}</g>
}

            <path d="M78 95 L79 90 M82 95 L84 90 M86 95 L85 90"

    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/BirchTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

function BirchLeaf({ cx, cy, size = 3, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#a8d97b', vein: '#7ab048', edge: '#6f9e3c' },
        mid:   { fill: '#6fb03d', vein: '#4a8a24', edge: '#3f7a2a' },
        deep:  { fill: '#4e8a3a', vein: '#2f6b22', edge: '#255c1a' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const s = size
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - s * 1.4}
                     C${cx + s * 0.9} ${cy - s * 1} ${cx + s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.2} ${cx + s * 0.6} ${cy + s * 0.5}
                     C${cx + s * 0.3} ${cy + s * 1.1} ${cx + s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.3} ${cx} ${cy + s * 1.4}
                     C${cx - s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.3} ${cx - s * 0.3} ${cy + s * 1.1} ${cx - s * 0.6} ${cy + s * 0.5}
                     C${cx - s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.2} ${cx - s * 0.9} ${cy - s * 1} ${cx} ${cy - s * 1.4} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.2} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.2}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.1} opacity="0.7"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 0.2} x2={cx + s * 0.6} y2={cy - s * 0.5}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.07} opacity="0.55"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 0.2} x2={cx - s * 0.6} y2={cy - s * 0.5}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.07} opacity="0.55"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function LeafCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 9, count = 22, seed = 0 }) {
    const leaves = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light', 'deep', 'mid']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        leaves.push(
            <BirchLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                       size={2.1 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 0.9}
                       rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                       tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{leaves}</g>
}

function BarkMark({ cx, cy, w = 1.3, h = 0.55, rot = 0, opacity = 0.9 }) {
    return (
        <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy} rx={w} ry={h}
                 fill="#1a1a1a" opacity={opacity}
                 transform={rot ? `rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})` : ''}/>
    )
}

function Ground() {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="96" rx="36" ry="4" fill="#8f6f52" opacity="0.7"/>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="95" rx="26" ry="2.5" fill="#b28c6e" opacity="0.85"/>
            <path d="M30 96 L29 92 M34 96 L35 91 M38 96 L37 92"
                  stroke="#5c8f4a" strokeWidth="0.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d="M62 96 L63 92 M66 96 L65 91 M70 96 L72 92"
                  stroke="#5c8f4a" strokeWidth="0.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function BirchTrunk({ topY = 20 }) {
    const marks = []
    let y = 88
    let i = 0
    while (y > topY + 4) {
        const jitter = (seededRandom(1, i) - 0.5) * 1.5
        const side = i % 2 === 0 ? -0.7 : 0.7
        marks.push(
            <BarkMark key={i} cx={50 + side + jitter} cy={y}
                      w={1.2 + seededRandom(2, i) * 0.5}
                      h={0.5 + seededRandom(3, i) * 0.15}
                      rot={(seededRandom(4, i) - 0.5) * 20}/>
        )
        y -= 6 + seededRandom(5, i) * 2
        i++
    }
    return (
        <g>
            <path d={`M50 96 L50 ${topY}`}
                  stroke="#f4f1e6" strokeWidth="4.2" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d={`M48.5 96 L48.5 ${topY + 2}`}
                  stroke="#d8d0be" strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
            <path d="M47 94 C46 90 47 86 48 83" stroke="#4e4238" strokeWidth="0.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
            <path d="M53 94 C54 90 53 86 52 83" stroke="#4e4238" strokeWidth="0.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
            {marks}
        </g>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/CherryTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

const PETAL = {
    light: { petal: '#ffd6e7', edge: '#f8a8c8', core: '#fff5c2' },
    mid:   { petal: '#ffa8c8', edge: '#e86a9a', core: '#ffd97a' },
    deep:  { petal: '#e86a9a', edge: '#b83e6c', core: '#f4b942' },
    blush: { petal: '#ffc0d4', edge: '#e89ab5', core: '#fff0b8' },
}

// Мелкий цветок вишни (одиночный лепесток с точкой)
function CherryBlossom({ cx, cy, r = 2.2, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const p = PETAL[tone] || PETAL.mid
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            {/* 5 мелких лепестков */}
            {[0, 72, 144, 216, 288].map((a, i) => {
                const rad = a * Math.PI / 180
                const px = cx + Math.cos(rad) * r * 0.6
                const py = cy + Math.sin(rad) * r * 0.6
                return (
                    <ellipse key={i} cx={px} cy={py} rx={r * 0.45} ry={r * 0.35}
                             transform={`rotate(${a} ${px} ${py})`}
                             fill={p.petal} stroke={p.edge} strokeWidth={r * 0.08}/>
                )
            })}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 0.22} fill={p.core}/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Тёмная вишенка (ягода) с бликом
function CherryBerry({ cx, cy, r = 2.4 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill="#8b0a2a"/>
            <circle cx={cx - r * 0.3} cy={cy - r * 0.3} r={r * 0.4} fill="#c9305a" opacity="0.8"/>
            <circle cx={cx - r * 0.4} cy={cy - r * 0.4} r={r * 0.15} fill="#fff" opacity="0.9"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Гроздь — 3-5 цветков плотно + редкая ягода
function BlossomCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 5, seed = 0, withBerry = true }) {
    const flowers = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'blush']
    const count = 4 + Math.floor(seededRandom(seed, 0) * 3)

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i + 1) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.1 + seededRandom(seed, i + 10) * 0.9)
        const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.7
        flowers.push(
            <CherryBlossom key={i} cx={px} cy={py}
                           r={radius * 0.4 + seededRandom(seed, i + 20) * radius * 0.15}
                           rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 30) * 360}
                           tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    if (withBerry && seededRandom(seed, 100) > 0.55) {
        flowers.push(
            <CherryBerry key="b" cx={cx - radius * 0.3} cy={cy + radius * 0.4}
                         r={radius * 0.45}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{flowers}</g>
}

// Каскад — серия гроздьев вдоль ветки
function BlossomCascade({ x1, y1, x2, y2, seed = 0, count = 4 }) {
    const items = []
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const t = (i + 1) / (count + 1)
        const cx = x1 + (x2 - x1) * t
        const cy = y1 + (y2 - y1) * t
        items.push(
            <BlossomCluster key={i} cx={cx} cy={cy}
                            radius={3.5 + seededRandom(seed, i) * 2}
                            seed={seed + i * 100}
                            withBerry={i % 2 === 0}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Прямой ствол с небольшим наклоном вправо
function CherryTrunk({ topY = 18 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Основной ствол — прямо, слегка наклонён */}
            <path d={`M50 96 C50.5 84 51.5 72 52 60 C52.5 48 53 36 52 ${topY}`}
                  stroke="#4a2418" strokeWidth="6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            {/* Блик */}
            <path d={`M47.5 90 C48 78 49 66 49.5 54 C50 42 50.5 30 50 ${topY + 2}`}
                  stroke="#7a4230" strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Полоски коры */}
            {[88, 78, 68, 58, 48, 38, 28].filter(y => y > topY).map((y, i) => (
                <line key={i}
                      x1={48 + (i % 2) * 0.5} y1={y}
                      x2={50 + (i % 2) * 0.5} y2={y + 2}
                      stroke="#2a1410" strokeWidth="0.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
            ))}
        </g>
    )
}

            <path d={`M82 ${topY + 40} C86 ${topY + 46} 90 ${topY + 52} 92 ${topY + 62}`} strokeWidth="0.9"/>

function CherryGround() {

export function SproutSVG() {
    return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet" aria-hidden="true">
            <CherryGround />
            {/* Тонкий росток с двумя каскадными веточками */}
            <path d="M50 94 C50 84 51 74 51 62" stroke="#4a2418" strokeWidth="2.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/CoconutTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Большой перистый лист (пальмовый)
function CoconutFrond({ x0, y0, x1, y1, tone = 'mid', side = 1, barbs = 14 }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#8fc55e', vein: '#5e8f36', edge: '#4a7a28' },
        mid:   { fill: '#5a9f3a', vein: '#3a7520', edge: '#2c5f18' },
        deep:  { fill: '#3f7a2a', vein: '#265418', edge: '#1c4610' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const midX = (x0 + x1) / 2
    const midY = (y0 + y1) / 2 - 8
    const items = []
    // Основная ветка
    items.push(
        <path key="stem" d={`M${x0} ${y0} Q${midX} ${midY} ${x1} ${y1}`}
              stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
    )
    // Мелкие перья вдоль
    for (let i = 1; i < barbs; i++) {
        const t = i / barbs
        const cx = x0 + (x1 - x0) * t + (midX - (x0 + x1) / 2) * (1 - Math.abs(2 * t - 1)) * 0.5
        const cy = y0 + (y1 - y0) * t + (midY - (y0 + y1) / 2) * (1 - Math.abs(2 * t - 1)) * 0.5
        const len = 4 + (1 - Math.abs(2 * t - 1)) * 4
        items.push(
            <path key={`a${i}`} d={`M${cx} ${cy} Q${cx + side * len * 0.6} ${cy - len * 0.4} ${cx + side * len} ${cy - len * 0.6}`}
                  stroke={c.fill} strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.9"/>
        )
        items.push(
            <path key={`b${i}`} d={`M${cx} ${cy} Q${cx + side * len * 0.6} ${cy + len * 0.3} ${cx + side * len} ${cy + len * 0.5}`}
                  stroke={c.fill} strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.8"/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Кокос — коричневый овал с пятнами
function Coconut({ cx, cy, r = 3 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy} rx={r} ry={r * 1.1} fill="#5c3a1e"/>
            <ellipse cx={cx - r * 0.3} cy={cy - r * 0.3} rx={r * 0.35} ry={r * 0.3} fill="#7a5233" opacity="0.7"/>
            <ellipse cx={cx + r * 0.3} cy={cy + r * 0.3} rx={r * 0.25} ry={r * 0.2} fill="#3a2412" opacity="0.6"/>
            <circle cx={cx - r * 0.2} cy={cy - r * 0.4} r={r * 0.1} fill="#2f1d14"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Крона — веер листьев на макушке
function CoconutCrown({ cx, cy, scale = 1 }) {
    const fronds = [
        { x1: cx - 32, y1: cy - 4,  tone: 'mid'   },
        { x1: cx + 32, y1: cy - 4,  tone: 'light' },
        { x1: cx - 24, y1: cy + 12, tone: 'deep'  },
        { x1: cx + 24, y1: cy + 12, tone: 'mid'   },
        { x1: cx - 20, y1: cy - 16, tone: 'light' },
        { x1: cx + 20, y1: cy - 16, tone: 'deep'  },
        { x1: cx - 10, y1: cy - 22, tone: 'mid'   },
        { x1: cx + 10, y1: cy - 22, tone: 'light' },
    ]
    return (
        <g>
            {fronds.map((f, i) => (
                <CoconutFrond key={i}
                              x0={cx} y0={cy}
                              x1={f.x1} y1={f.y1}
                              tone={f.tone}
                              side={f.x1 < cx ? 1 : -1}
                              barbs={14}/>
            ))}
        </g>
    )
}

// Высокий изогнутый ствол
function CoconutTrunk({ topY = 20, curve = 6 }) {
    // Ствол изогнут вправо
    const segments = []
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        const t = i / 13
        const y = 96 - t * (96 - topY)
        const x = 50 + Math.sin(t * 0.6) * curve
        segments.push({ x, y })
    }
    const pathD = `M${segments[0].x} ${segments[0].y} ` +
        segments.slice(1).map(s => `L${s.x} ${s.y}`).join(' ')

    return (
        <g>
            <path d={pathD}
                  stroke="#8a6b3d" strokeWidth="5.5" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d={pathD}
                  stroke="#a88352" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Кольца на стволе */}
            {segments.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0).map((s, i) => (
                <ellipse key={i} cx={s.x} cy={s.y} rx={2.6} ry={0.8}
                         fill="#5c4322" opacity="0.85"/>
            ))}
        </g>
    )
}

function CoconutGround() {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="96" rx="38" ry="4" fill="#c8a878" opacity="0.85"/>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="95" rx="28" ry="2.6" fill="#e0c89a" opacity="0.9"/>
            <Coconut cx={22} cy={96} r={2.2}/>
            <Coconut cx={78} cy={96} r={2}/>
        </g>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/common.jsx ====================
// Общие утилиты и SVG-компоненты для деревьев.

export function seededRandom(seed, i) {
    const x = Math.sin(seed * 9301 + i * 49297) * 233280
    return x - Math.floor(x)
}

export function Sparkle({ cx, cy, r = 1.6, rot = 0, fill = '#ffe9a8', stroke = '#f4b942' }) {
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`} opacity="0.9">
            <path
                d={`M${cx} ${cy - r * 2} L${cx + r * 0.4} ${cy - r * 0.4} L${cx + r * 2} ${cy}
                    L${cx + r * 0.4} ${cy + r * 0.4} L${cx} ${cy + r * 2}
                    L${cx - r * 0.4} ${cy + r * 0.4} L${cx - r * 2} ${cy}
                    L${cx - r * 0.4} ${cy - r * 0.4} Z`}
                fill={fill}
                stroke={stroke}
                strokeWidth={r * 0.15}
            />
        </g>
    )
}

export function SparkleRing({ colorScheme = 'yellow' }) {
    const palette = {
        yellow: { fill: '#ffe9a8', stroke: '#f4b942' },
        pink:   { fill: '#ffd3e6', stroke: '#d34f8c' },
        green:  { fill: '#e8f5c8', stroke: '#a8d97b' },
    }[colorScheme] || { fill: '#ffe9a8', stroke: '#f4b942' }

    return (
        <g>
            <Sparkle cx={14} cy={30} r={1.6} rot={20}  {...palette} />
            <Sparkle cx={86} cy={22} r={1.4} rot={-15} {...palette} />
            <Sparkle cx={30} cy={12} r={1.8} rot={45}  {...palette} />
            <Sparkle cx={70} cy={10} r={1.5} rot={-30} {...palette} />
            <Sparkle cx={10} cy={50} r={1.3} rot={10}  {...palette} />
            <Sparkle cx={92} cy={44} r={1.3} rot={-40} {...palette} />
            <Sparkle cx={50} cy={6}  r={1.6} rot={0}   {...palette} />
        </g>
    )
}

export function Aura({ id, color1, color2 }) {
    return (
        <defs>
            <radialGradient id={id} cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
                <stop offset="0%"   stopColor={color1} stopOpacity="0.32" />
                <stop offset="60%"  stopColor={color2} stopOpacity="0.14" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor={color2} stopOpacity="0" />
            </radialGradient>
        </defs>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/CrystalTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// ============================================================
// КРИСТАЛЛ — ромбовидный, многослойный, с гранями
// ============================================================
function CrystalGem({ cx, cy, size = 6, rot = 0, tone = 'mid', opacity = 1 }) {
    // Палитра: светлые и тёмные грани, прозрачные
    const tones = {
        light: { top: '#e8f8fa', left: '#b8e2e8', right: '#88c8d0', edge: '#5aa8b0', glow: '#b8e2e8' },
        mid:   { top: '#d4f0f4', left: '#a8d8e0', right: '#78b8c8', edge: '#4a98a8', glow: '#a8d8e0' },
        deep:  { top: '#b8e0e8', left: '#88c0cc', right: '#5aa0b0', edge: '#3a8090', glow: '#88c0cc' },
        clear: { top: '#f0fafc', left: '#d0e8ec', right: '#a8d0d8', edge: '#70a8b0', glow: '#d0e8ec' },
    }
    const c = tones[tone] || tones.mid
    const w = size * 0.5
    const h = size

    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`} opacity={opacity}>
            {/* Мягкое свечение (не неон) */}
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy} rx={w * 1.8} ry={h * 1.6}
                     fill={c.glow} opacity="0.25"/>
            {/* Правая грань (тень) */}
            <polygon
                points={`${cx},${cy - h} ${cx + w},${cy} ${cx},${cy + h} ${cx},${cy - h}`}
                fill={c.right}
                stroke={c.edge}
                strokeWidth="0.2"
            />
            {/* Левая грань (свет) */}
            <polygon
                points={`${cx},${cy - h} ${cx - w},${cy} ${cx},${cy + h} ${cx},${cy - h}`}
                fill={c.left}
                stroke={c.edge}
                strokeWidth="0.2"
            />
            {/* Верхняя светлая грань */}
            <polygon
                points={`${cx},${cy - h} ${cx + w * 0.5},${cy - h * 0.3} ${cx},${cy - h * 0.1} ${cx - w * 0.5},${cy - h * 0.3}`}
                fill={c.top}
                stroke={c.edge}
                strokeWidth="0.15"
            />
            {/* Нижний тёмный кончик */}
            <polygon
                points={`${cx},${cy + h} ${cx + w * 0.35},${cy + h * 0.6} ${cx},${cy + h * 0.5} ${cx - w * 0.35},${cy + h * 0.6}`}
                fill={c.right}
                opacity="0.7"
                stroke={c.edge}
                strokeWidth="0.15"
            />
            {/* Блик */}
            <polygon
                points={`${cx - w * 0.3},${cy - h * 0.5} ${cx - w * 0.1},${cy - h * 0.2} ${cx - w * 0.3},${cy - h * 0.1} ${cx - w * 0.5},${cy - h * 0.3}`}
                fill="#ffffff"
                opacity="0.85"
            />
        </g>
    )
}

// Мелкий кристаллик на ветке
function SmallCrystal({ cx, cy, size = 3, rot = 0 }) {
    return <CrystalGem cx={cx} cy={cy} size={size} rot={rot} tone="mid"/>
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/CypressTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Мелкие плотные иглы (треугольники)
function CypressNeedle({ cx, cy, len = 2.5, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#4a7a2a', edge: '#2f5a18' },
        mid:   { fill: '#2f5a18', edge: '#1c3c0c' },
        deep:  { fill: '#1f4a10', edge: '#0f2f06' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - len} L${cx + len * 0.4} ${cy + len * 0.4} L${cx - len * 0.4} ${cy + len * 0.4} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth="0.2"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Кластер игл — плотная тёмная масса
function CypressCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 6, count = 20, seed = 0 }) {
    const needles = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.1 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const nx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ny = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.9
        needles.push(
            <CypressNeedle key={i} cx={nx} cy={ny}
                           len={1.8 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 0.8}
                           rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                           tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{needles}</g>
}

// Прямой тонкий ствол
function CypressTrunk({ topY = 20 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <path d={`M50 96 L50 ${topY}`}
                  stroke="#4a3018" strokeWidth="3.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d={`M48.5 96 L48.5 ${topY + 2}`}
                  stroke="#6b4a2b" strokeWidth="0.9" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Полоски */}
            {[88, 78, 68, 58, 48, 38, 28].filter(y => y > topY).map((y, i) => (
                <line key={i} x1={49 + (i % 2) * 0.5} y1={y}
                      x2={50 + (i % 2) * 0.5} y2={y + 1}
                      stroke="#2a1a08" strokeWidth="0.5" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
            ))}
        </g>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/EucalyptusTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Серо-голубой лист эвкалипта — узкий серп
function EucalyptusLeaf({ cx, cy, size = 4, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#b8c8d4', vein: '#8a9aa8', edge: '#7a8a98' },
        mid:   { fill: '#8a9fae', vein: '#5a6f80', edge: '#4a5f70' },
        deep:  { fill: '#5a7080', vein: '#3a4f60', edge: '#2a3f50' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const s = size
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - s * 1.8}
                     C${cx + s * 0.7} ${cy - s * 1} ${cx + s * 0.8} ${cy + s * 0.3} ${cx} ${cy + s * 1.8}
                     C${cx - s * 0.8} ${cy + s * 0.3} ${cx - s * 0.7} ${cy - s * 1} ${cx} ${cy - s * 1.8} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.5} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.5}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.08} opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function EucalyptusCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 8, count = 12, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <EucalyptusLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                            size={2.4 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1}
                            rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                            tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

            <path d="M52 84 C52 76 53 68 51 60"
                  stroke="#8a7a66" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
            {/* Отслаивающиеся пятна */}
            <ellipse cx={46} cy={78} rx={1.5} ry={0.7} fill="#9a8a76" opacity="0.7"/>

function EucalyptusGround() {

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/FirTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

function FirNeedle({ cx, cy, len = 3, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#2f6b2a', edge: '#1f4a1c' },
        mid:   { fill: '#1c4a18', edge: '#0f2f0e' },
        deep:  { fill: '#0f2f0e', edge: '#061806' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - len} L${cx + len * 0.4} ${cy + len * 0.4} L${cx - len * 0.4} ${cy + len * 0.4} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth="0.2"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function FirCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 8, count = 24, seed = 0 }) {
    const needles = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'deep']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.1 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const nx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ny = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.9
        needles.push(
            <FirNeedle key={i} cx={nx} cy={ny}
                       len={2 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 0.9}
                       rot={(a * 180 / Math.PI) + 180}
                       tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{needles}</g>
}

function FirTrunk() {
    return <path d="M48 96 L52 96 L51 86 L49 86 Z" fill="#4a2f18"/>
}

function FirGround() {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="96" rx="38" ry="4" fill="#4a5a2a" opacity="0.85"/>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="95" rx="28" ry="2.6" fill="#6a7a3a" opacity="0.9"/>
            <circle cx="22" cy="95" r="0.5" fill="#8a9a5a" opacity="0.6"/>
            <circle cx="78" cy="95" r="0.5" fill="#8a9a5a" opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
    )
}

        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet" aria-hidden="true">
            <FirGround />

            <polygon points="50,70 40,88 60,88" fill="#2f6b2a" stroke="#0f2f0e" strokeWidth="0.4"/>
            <FirTrunk />
        </svg>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/JacarandaTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

const JACARANDA_TONES = {
    light: { petal: '#e1bee7', edge: '#ba68c8', core: '#fff59d' },
    mid:   { petal: '#ba68c8', edge: '#8e24aa', core: '#ffd54f' },
    deep:  { petal: '#9c27b0', edge: '#6a1b9a', core: '#ffb300' },
    blue:  { petal: '#9575cd', edge: '#512da8', core: '#ffca28' },
}

// Трубчатый цветок джакаранды
function JacarandaFlower({ cx, cy, r = 2.5, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const p = JACARANDA_TONES[tone] || JACARANDA_TONES.mid
    const petals = []
    // 5 лепестков, тонкие
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = i * 72 + rot
        const rad = a * Math.PI / 180
        const px = cx + Math.cos(rad) * r * 0.55
        const py = cy + Math.sin(rad) * r * 0.55
        petals.push(
            <ellipse key={i} cx={px} cy={py} rx={r * 0.5} ry={r * 0.35}
                     transform={`rotate(${a} ${px} ${py})`}
                     fill={p.petal} stroke={p.edge} strokeWidth={r * 0.08}/>
        )
    }
    return (
        <g>
            {petals}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 0.2} fill={p.core}/>
        </g>
    )
}

function JacarandaCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 8, count = 18, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'blue', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <JacarandaFlower key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                             r={1.8 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 0.8}
                             rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                             tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Ствол — светлый серо-коричневый, тонкий

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/LemonTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Мелкий лист лимона
function LemonLeaf({ cx, cy, r = 3, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#7cb342', vein: '#5a8f28', edge: '#4a7a20' },
        mid:   { fill: '#4e8a24', vein: '#2f6b22', edge: '#255c1a' },
        deep:  { fill: '#3a6e18', vein: '#1f4a10', edge: '#163808' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const s = r
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - s * 1.3}
                     C${cx + s * 0.85} ${cy - s * 1} ${cx + s * 1} ${cy - s * 0.2} ${cx + s * 0.55} ${cy + s * 0.5}
                     C${cx + s * 0.3} ${cy + s * 1} ${cx + s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.2} ${cx} ${cy + s * 1.3}
                     C${cx - s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.2} ${cx - s * 0.3} ${cy + s * 1} ${cx - s * 0.55} ${cy + s * 0.5}
                     C${cx - s * 1} ${cy - s * 0.2} ${cx - s * 0.85} ${cy - s * 1} ${cx} ${cy - s * 1.3} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.1} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.1}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.1} opacity="0.7"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Лимон — жёлтый овал с «носиками»
function LemonFruit({ cx, cy, r = 3.5 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy} rx={r * 0.85} ry={r * 1.15} fill="#ffeb3b"/>
            {/* Тёмная сторона */}
            <ellipse cx={cx + r * 0.2} cy={cy + r * 0.2} rx={r * 0.55} ry={r * 0.8}
                     fill="#f9a825" opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Блик */}
            <ellipse cx={cx - r * 0.3} cy={cy - r * 0.4} rx={r * 0.2} ry={r * 0.35}
                     fill="#fffde7" opacity="0.9"/>
            {/* Носик сверху */}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy - r * 1.1} r={r * 0.15} fill="#c8a415"/>
            {/* Носик снизу */}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy + r * 1.1} r={r * 0.15} fill="#c8a415"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function LemonCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 8, count = 14, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <LemonLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                       r={2.4 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 0.9}
                       rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                       tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    // Яркие лимоны — много
    if (seededRandom(seed, 400) > 0.3) {
        items.push(
            <LemonFruit key="l1" cx={cx + radius * 0.25} cy={cy + radius * 0.3}
                        r={2.4 + seededRandom(seed, 500) * 0.8}/>
        )
    }
    if (seededRandom(seed, 600) > 0.5) {
        items.push(
            <LemonFruit key="l2" cx={cx - radius * 0.35} cy={cy + radius * 0.1}
                        r={2.2 + seededRandom(seed, 700) * 0.7}/>
        )
    }
    if (seededRandom(seed, 800) > 0.65) {
        items.push(
            <LemonFruit key="l3" cx={cx + radius * 0.4} cy={cy - radius * 0.2}
                        r={2 + seededRandom(seed, 900) * 0.6}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/MangoTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Крупный овальный лист манго (с заострённым кончиком)
function MangoLeaf({ cx, cy, r = 4, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#6fb03d', vein: '#4a8a24', edge: '#3f7a2a' },
        mid:   { fill: '#3e7a1e', vein: '#265418', edge: '#1c4610' },
        deep:  { fill: '#2a5c14', vein: '#184210', edge: '#0f2f0a' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const s = r
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - s * 1.8}
                     C${cx + s * 0.9} ${cy - s * 1.3} ${cx + s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.3} ${cx + s * 0.5} ${cy + s * 0.6}
                     C${cx + s * 0.2} ${cy + s * 1.3} ${cx + s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.6} ${cx} ${cy + s * 1.8}
                     C${cx - s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.6} ${cx - s * 0.2} ${cy + s * 1.3} ${cx - s * 0.5} ${cy + s * 0.6}
                     C${cx - s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.3} ${cx - s * 0.9} ${cy - s * 1.3} ${cx} ${cy - s * 1.8} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.6} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.6}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.1} opacity="0.7"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Крупное манго — жёлто-оранжевый овал с румянцем
function MangoFruit({ cx, cy, r = 4 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy} rx={r} ry={r * 1.25} fill="#ffa726"/>
            {/* Красный румянец */}
            <ellipse cx={cx + r * 0.35} cy={cy - r * 0.2} rx={r * 0.5} ry={r * 0.7}
                     fill="#e64a19" opacity="0.75"/>
            {/* Блик */}
            <ellipse cx={cx - r * 0.3} cy={cy - r * 0.4} rx={r * 0.3} ry={r * 0.4}
                     fill="#ffe0b2" opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Хвостик */}
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r * 1.2} x2={cx + r * 0.1} y2={cy - r * 1.5}
                  stroke="#4d3a2a" strokeWidth={r * 0.12} strokeLinecap="round"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function MangoCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 9, count = 14, seed = 0, withMango = true }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <MangoLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                       r={3.2 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1.2}
                       rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                       tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    if (withMango && seededRandom(seed, 400) > 0.5) {
        items.push(
            <MangoFruit key="m1" cx={cx + radius * 0.3} cy={cy + radius * 0.3}
                        r={3 + seededRandom(seed, 500) * 1}/>
        )
    }
    if (withMango && seededRandom(seed, 600) > 0.65) {
        items.push(
            <MangoFruit key="m2" cx={cx - radius * 0.4} cy={cy + radius * 0.1}
                        r={2.6 + seededRandom(seed, 700) * 0.8}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/MapleTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

const MAPLE_TONES = {
    red:    { fill: '#d32f2f', edge: '#8b0000', vein: '#5a0000' },
    orange: { fill: '#ff6f00', edge: '#b34700', vein: '#7a2e00' },
    amber:  { fill: '#ffa726', edge: '#c77800', vein: '#8a5200' },
    gold:   { fill: '#ffca28', edge: '#c79a00', vein: '#8a6a00' },
    deep:   { fill: '#b71c1c', edge: '#7a0000', vein: '#4a0000' },
}

// Кленовый лист — 5 лопастей (звёздочка)
function MapleLeaf({ cx, cy, r = 4, rot = 0, tone = 'orange' }) {
    const c = MAPLE_TONES[tone] || MAPLE_TONES.orange
    const s = r
    // 5-лопастная форма
    const d = `M${cx} ${cy - s * 1.3}
        L${cx + s * 0.35} ${cy - s * 0.5}
        L${cx + s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.7}
        L${cx + s * 0.5} ${cy}
        L${cx + s * 1} ${cy + s * 0.6}
        L${cx + s * 0.25} ${cy + s * 0.4}
        L${cx} ${cy + s * 1.2}
        L${cx - s * 0.25} ${cy + s * 0.4}
        L${cx - s * 1} ${cy + s * 0.6}
        L${cx - s * 0.5} ${cy}
        L${cx - s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.7}
        L${cx - s * 0.35} ${cy - s * 0.5} Z`
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={d} fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08} strokeLinejoin="round"/>
            {/* Центральная жилка */}
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.1} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.05}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.08} opacity="0.6"/>
            {/* Боковые жилки */}
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 0.2} x2={cx + s * 0.9} y2={cy - s * 0.6}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.06} opacity="0.5"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 0.2} x2={cx - s * 0.9} y2={cy - s * 0.6}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.06} opacity="0.5"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy + s * 0.2} x2={cx + s * 0.8} y2={cy + s * 0.55}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.06} opacity="0.5"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy + s * 0.2} x2={cx - s * 0.8} y2={cy + s * 0.55}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.06} opacity="0.5"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function MapleCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 9, count = 14, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['red', 'orange', 'amber', 'gold', 'deep', 'orange']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <MapleLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                       r={3 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1.2}
                       rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                       tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Прямой ствол с корой
function MapleTrunk({ topY = 20 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <path d={`M50 96 C48 84 52 70 50 56 C48 42 52 30 50 ${topY}`}
                  stroke="#6b4423" strokeWidth="8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            {/* Светлая сторона */}
            <path d={`M47 90 C45 80 49 68 47 56`}
                  stroke="#8a5c32" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Тёмная сторона */}
            <path d={`M53 86 C53 76 51 68 52 58`}
                  stroke="#3a2412" strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
            {/* Кора — трещины */}
            <path d="M45 76 C44 70 46 64 48 60" stroke="#2f1d14" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            <path d="M53 64 C52 58 53 52 52 46" stroke="#2f1d14" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            <path d="M48 40 C48 36 49 32 50 28" stroke="#2f1d14" strokeWidth="0.7" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Раскидистые ветки
function MapleBranches({ topY = 16 }) {
    return (
        <g stroke="#6b4423" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none">
            {/* Верхние */}
            <path d={`M50 ${topY + 4} C42 ${topY - 4} 34 ${topY - 8} 26 ${topY - 4}`} strokeWidth="3.4"/>
            <path d={`M50 ${topY + 4} C58 ${topY - 4} 66 ${topY - 8} 74 ${topY - 4}`} strokeWidth="3.4"/>

            {/* Средние */}
            <path d={`M50 ${topY + 16} C38 ${topY + 10} 24 ${topY + 8} 12 ${topY + 14}`} strokeWidth="4"/>
            <path d={`M50 ${topY + 16} C62 ${topY + 10} 76 ${topY + 8} 88 ${topY + 14}`} strokeWidth="4"/>

            {/* Нижние */}

            <path d={`M74 ${topY - 4} C80 ${topY - 10} 86 ${topY - 12} 92 ${topY - 8}`} strokeWidth="2"/>
            <path d={`M12 ${topY + 14} C6 ${topY + 18} 4 ${topY + 24} 6 ${topY + 30}`} strokeWidth="1.8"/>
            <path d={`M88 ${topY + 14} C94 ${topY + 18} 96 ${topY + 24} 94 ${topY + 30}`} strokeWidth="1.8"/>
        </g>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/NeonTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

const NEON_COLORS = ['#00f5ff', '#ff00e5', '#7b2ff7', '#00ffaa', '#ff0080', '#00b8ff']

// Светящаяся точка-узел
function NeonNode({ cx, cy, r = 1.5, color = '#00f5ff', pulse = false }) {
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Большое свечение */}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 4} fill={color} opacity="0.1">
                {pulse && (
                    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.05;0.2;0.05" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
                )}
            </circle>
            {/* Среднее свечение */}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 2.5} fill={color} opacity="0.3"/>
            {/* Ядро */}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill={color}/>
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 0.4} fill="#ffffff"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Неоновая вена — изогнутая линия со свечением
function NeonVein({ d, width = 1.5, color = '#00f5ff', dashed = false }) {
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Внешнее свечение */}
            <path d={d} stroke={color} strokeWidth={width * 4} opacity="0.15"
                  strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            {/* Среднее */}
            <path d={d} stroke={color} strokeWidth={width * 2} opacity="0.45"
                  strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            {/* Ядро */}
            <path d={d} stroke={color} strokeWidth={width} opacity="0.95"
                  strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"
                  strokeDasharray={dashed ? '2 3' : undefined}/>
            {/* Белая сердцевина */}
            <path d={d} stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth={width * 0.4} opacity="0.9"
                  strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Ветка — вена + узлы + подветки
function NeonBranch({ d, color = '#00f5ff', seed = 0, subBranches = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    items.push(<NeonVein key="main" d={d} width={2} color={color}/>)

    // Подветки — короткие вены
    for (let i = 0; i < subBranches; i++) {
        const t = 0.3 + seededRandom(seed, i) * 0.6
        const parts = d.split(/[MCQ]/).filter(Boolean)
        // Приблизительно берём точку на ветке
        const subD = `M${40 + seededRandom(seed, i + 10) * 20} ${30 + seededRandom(seed, i + 20) * 20} Q${30 + seededRandom(seed, i + 30) * 40} ${20 + seededRandom(seed, i + 40) * 20} ${20 + seededRandom(seed, i + 50) * 60} ${15 + seededRandom(seed, i + 60) * 25}`
        const subColor = NEON_COLORS[(seed + i) % NEON_COLORS.length]
        items.push(
            <NeonVein key={`sub${i}`} d={subD} width={1.2} color={subColor}/>
        )
    }

    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Асимметричное дерево — ствол с наклоном
function NeonTrunk({ topY = 20 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Основной ствол — изогнут влево-вправо */}
            <NeonVein d={`M50 96 Q46 80 52 68 T50 ${topY}`}
                      width={2.6} color="#00f5ff"/>

            {/* Боковые вены-обмотки по стволу */}
            <NeonVein d={`M49 90 Q52 82 48 74 T50 62`} width={1.2} color="#ff00e5"/>
            <NeonVein d={`M51 78 Q48 70 53 60 T50 ${topY + 4}`} width={1} color="#00ffaa"/>

            {/* Узлы по стволу */}
            <NeonNode cx={50} cy={88} r={1.2} color="#00f5ff"/>
            <NeonNode cx={49} cy={78} r={1} color="#ff00e5"/>
            <NeonNode cx={51} cy={68} r={1.3} color="#00ffaa"/>
            <NeonNode cx={50} cy={58} r={1.1} color="#7b2ff7"/>
            <NeonNode cx={50} cy={48} r={1.4} color="#00f5ff"/>
            <NeonNode cx={50} cy={38} r={1.2} color="#ff0080"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Асимметричная крона — вены, узлы, искры
function NeonCrown({ seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []

    // Верхние ветки — асимметрично
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b1"
                           d="M50 30 Q42 22 30 18 T12 14"
                           color="#00f5ff" seed={seed + 1} subBranches={2}/>)
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b2"
                           d="M50 28 Q60 20 72 22 T90 26"
                           color="#ff00e5" seed={seed + 2} subBranches={2}/>)

    // Средние ветки — длиннее справа
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b3"
                           d="M50 44 Q38 36 24 40 T6 48"
                           color="#7b2ff7" seed={seed + 3} subBranches={2}/>)
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b4"
                           d="M50 42 Q66 32 82 38 T98 44"
                           color="#00ffaa" seed={seed + 4} subBranches={3}/>)

    // Нижние ветки
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b5"
                           d="M50 58 Q40 54 30 60 T14 72"
                           color="#ff0080" seed={seed + 5} subBranches={2}/>)
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b6"
                           d="M50 58 Q62 58 74 66 T90 78"
                           color="#00f5ff" seed={seed + 6} subBranches={2}/>)

    // Верхние тонкие веточки-щупальца
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b7"
                           d="M50 20 Q48 12 44 6 T38 -2"
                           color="#ff00e5" seed={seed + 7} subBranches={0}/>)
    items.push(<NeonBranch key="b8"
                           d="M50 22 Q56 16 64 12 T76 6"
                           color="#00f5ff" seed={seed + 8} subBranches={0}/>)

    // Множество узлов-искр
    const nodes = [
        [12, 14, 1.4], [30, 18, 1.2], [50, 14, 1.5], [72, 22, 1.3], [90, 26, 1.4],
        [6, 48, 1.3], [24, 40, 1.1], [50, 32, 1.5], [82, 38, 1.4], [98, 44, 1.2],
        [14, 72, 1.2], [30, 60, 1.1], [74, 66, 1.2], [90, 78, 1.3],
        [38, -2, 1], [76, 6, 1.1], [44, 6, 0.9], [64, 12, 1],
    ]
    nodes.forEach(([x, y, r], i) => {
        const c = NEON_COLORS[i % NEON_COLORS.length]
        items.push(<NeonNode key={`n${i}`} cx={x} cy={y} r={r} color={c} pulse={i % 3 === 0}/>)
    })

    // Свободные искры вокруг
    const sparks = [
        [8, 8, 0.8, '#00f5ff'], [92, 10, 1, '#ff00e5'], [4, 62, 0.9, '#00ffaa'],
        [96, 66, 1, '#7b2ff7'], [20, 90, 0.7, '#ff0080'], [80, 90, 0.9, '#00f5ff'],
        [40, 4, 0.8, '#00ffaa'], [60, 2, 0.9, '#ff00e5'],
    ]
    sparks.forEach(([x, y, r, c], i) => {
        items.push(<NeonNode key={`s${i}`} cx={x} cy={y} r={r} color={c}/>)
    })

    return <g>{items}</g>
}

function NeonGround() {

            {/* Светящееся кольцо по земле */}
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="95" rx="32" ry="2.8" fill="none"
                     stroke="#00f5ff" strokeWidth="0.5" opacity="0.7"/>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="95" rx="24" ry="2" fill="none"
                     stroke="#ff00e5" strokeWidth="0.4" opacity="0.5"/>
            {/* Корни-вены */}
            <NeonVein d="M48 94 Q40 92 32 95" width={1.2} color="#00f5ff"/>

}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/OakTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

function OakLeaf({ cx, cy, r = 5, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#a8c66c', vein: '#7a9c40', edge: '#6a8c30' },
        mid:   { fill: '#6b9b3c', vein: '#4a7028', edge: '#3a5a1e' },
        deep:  { fill: '#4a7028', vein: '#2f4d18', edge: '#243c10' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const d = `M${cx} ${cy - r * 1.4}
        C${cx + r * 0.4} ${cy - r * 1.5} ${cx + r * 0.8} ${cy - r * 1.2} ${cx + r * 0.7} ${cy - r * 0.8}
        C${cx + r * 1.2} ${cy - r * 0.7} ${cx + r * 1.3} ${cy - r * 0.2} ${cx + r * 0.9} ${cy + r * 0.2}
        C${cx + r * 1.2} ${cy + r * 0.6} ${cx + r * 0.9} ${cy + r * 1.1} ${cx + r * 0.4} ${cy + r * 1.1}
        C${cx + r * 0.1} ${cy + r * 1.5} ${cx - r * 0.1} ${cy + r * 1.5} ${cx - r * 0.4} ${cy + r * 1.1}
        C${cx - r * 0.9} ${cy + r * 1.1} ${cx - r * 1.2} ${cy + r * 0.6} ${cx - r * 0.9} ${cy + r * 0.2}
        C${cx - r * 1.3} ${cy - r * 0.2} ${cx - r * 1.2} ${cy - r * 0.7} ${cx - r * 0.7} ${cy - r * 0.8}
        C${cx - r * 0.8} ${cy - r * 1.2} ${cx - r * 0.4} ${cy - r * 1.5} ${cx} ${cy - r * 1.4} Z`
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={d} fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={r * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r * 1.1} x2={cx} y2={cy + r * 1.1}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={r * 0.1} opacity="0.7"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r * 0.3} x2={cx + r * 0.6} y2={cy - r * 0.5}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={r * 0.07} opacity="0.55"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r * 0.3} x2={cx - r * 0.6} y2={cy - r * 0.5}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={r * 0.07} opacity="0.55"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function Acorn({ cx, cy, r = 3 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy + r * 0.4} rx={r * 0.9} ry={r * 1.1} fill="#b8843c"/>
            <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy - r * 0.3} rx={r * 1.1} ry={r * 0.7} fill="#7a5228"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r * 1} x2={cx} y2={cy - r * 1.4}
                  stroke="#4a2f18" strokeWidth={r * 0.2} strokeLinecap="round"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function OakCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 10, count = 18, seed = 0 }) {
    const leaves = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        leaves.push(
            <OakLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                     r={3.2 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1.2}
                     rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                     tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    if (seededRandom(seed, 500) > 0.6) {
        leaves.push(<Acorn key="ac1" cx={cx + radius * 0.3} cy={cy + radius * 0.5} r={2.4}/>)
    }
    if (seededRandom(seed, 600) > 0.75) {
        leaves.push(<Acorn key="ac2" cx={cx - radius * 0.4} cy={cy + radius * 0.3} r={2.2}/>)
    }
    return <g>{leaves}</g>
}

// ТОЛСТЫЙ МАССИВНЫЙ ствол — фишка дуба
function OakTrunk({ topY = 20 }) {
    const marks = []
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const y = 90 - i * 8
        const side = i % 2 === 0 ? -1.5 : 1.5
        marks.push(
            <ellipse key={i} cx={50 + side} cy={y} rx={1.2} ry={0.5}
                     fill="#2f1d14" opacity="0.75"/>
        )
    }
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Основной ствол — ТОЛСТЫЙ, массивный, чуть расширяется к земле */}
            <path d={`M50 96 C46 88 48 76 50 64 C52 50 50 36 50 ${topY}`}
                  stroke="#3a2412" strokeWidth="14" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            {/* Светлая сторона */}
            <path d={`M45 92 C42 82 44 72 46 62 C48 50 46 38 46 ${topY + 2}`}
                  stroke="#5c3a1e" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.75"/>
            {/* Тёмная сторона */}
            <path d={`M56 90 C57 80 55 70 54 60 C53 48 54 36 54 ${topY + 2}`}
                  stroke="#1f1208" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
            {/* Трещины коры */}
            {[88, 78, 68, 58, 48, 38, 28].filter(y => y > topY).map((y, i) => (
                <ellipse key={`b${i}`} cx={50 + ((i % 2 === 0) ? -3 : 3)} cy={y}
                         rx={1.4} ry={0.6}
                         fill="#1f1208" opacity="0.6"/>
            ))}
            {marks}
        </g>
    )
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/OrangeTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

// Блестящий лист апельсина (тёмный, глянцевый)
function OrangeLeaf({ cx, cy, r = 4, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#4a9f2a', vein: '#2a6a14', edge: '#1f5010' },
        mid:   { fill: '#2f7a1a', vein: '#1a5510', edge: '#12400c' },
        deep:  { fill: '#1f5c0f', vein: '#0f3a08', edge: '#0a2a06' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    const s = r
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - s * 1.4}
                     C${cx + s * 0.9} ${cy - s * 1.1} ${cx + s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.2} ${cx + s * 0.6} ${cy + s * 0.6}
                     C${cx + s * 0.3} ${cy + s * 1.1} ${cx + s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.3} ${cx} ${cy + s * 1.4}
                     C${cx - s * 0.05} ${cy + s * 1.3} ${cx - s * 0.3} ${cy + s * 1.1} ${cx - s * 0.6} ${cy + s * 0.6}
                     C${cx - s * 1.1} ${cy - s * 0.2} ${cx - s * 0.9} ${cy - s * 1.1} ${cx} ${cy - s * 1.4} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.2} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.2}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.1} opacity="0.7"/>
            {/* Блеск */}
            <ellipse cx={cx - s * 0.3} cy={cy - s * 0.5}
                     rx={s * 0.3} ry={s * 0.15}
                     fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Апельсин — оранжевый шар с блеском
function OrangeFruit({ cx, cy, r = 4 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill="#ff6f00"/>
            <circle cx={cx + r * 0.2} cy={cy + r * 0.3} r={r * 0.75}
                    fill="#e65100" opacity="0.6"/>
            <circle cx={cx - r * 0.35} cy={cy - r * 0.4} r={r * 0.3} fill="#ffb74d" opacity="0.85"/>
            <circle cx={cx - r * 0.4} cy={cy - r * 0.5} r={r * 0.12} fill="#fff3e0" opacity="0.95"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - r} x2={cx} y2={cy - r * 1.3}
                  stroke="#4d3a2a" strokeWidth={r * 0.12} strokeLinecap="round"/>
            <ellipse cx={cx + r * 0.3} cy={cy - r * 1.2} rx={r * 0.4} ry={r * 0.2}
                     fill="#4a9f2a" opacity="0.9"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function OrangeCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 9, count = 14, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.05 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const lx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ly = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.85
        items.push(
            <OrangeLeaf key={i} cx={lx} cy={ly}
                        r={3 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1.1}
                        rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 300) * 360}
                        tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    // Яркие апельсины — много
    if (seededRandom(seed, 400) > 0.3) {
        items.push(
            <OrangeFruit key="o1" cx={cx + radius * 0.2} cy={cy + radius * 0.3}
                         r={2.6 + seededRandom(seed, 500) * 0.8}/>
        )
    }
    if (seededRandom(seed, 600) > 0.5) {
        items.push(
            <OrangeFruit key="o2" cx={cx - radius * 0.4} cy={cy + radius * 0.1}
                         r={2.4 + seededRandom(seed, 700) * 0.7}/>
        )
    }
    if (seededRandom(seed, 800) > 0.7) {
        items.push(
            <OrangeFruit key="o3" cx={cx + radius * 0.4} cy={cy - radius * 0.2}
                         r={2.2 + seededRandom(seed, 900) * 0.6}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/PalmTree.jsx ====================
import { SparkleRing } from './common'

function PalmLeaf({ x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, side = 1, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const colors = { light: '#c4e07a', mid: '#7cba3c', deep: '#3e7a1e' }
    const c = colors[tone] || colors.mid
    const midX = (x0 + x1) / 2
    const midY = (y0 + y1) / 2
    const barbs = []
    for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
        const t = i / 7
        const cx = x0 + (x1 - x0) * t
        const cy = y0 + (y1 - y0) * t
        barbs.push(<line key={`a${i}`} x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={cx + side * 3} y2={cy - 2}
                         stroke={c} strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>)
        barbs.push(<line key={`b${i}`} x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={cx + side * 3} y2={cy + 2}
                         stroke={c} strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.75"/>)
    }
    return (
        <g>
            <path d={`M${x0} ${y0} Q${midX} ${midY} ${x1} ${y1} Q${x2} ${y2} ${x0} ${y0}`}
                  fill={c} opacity="0.85"/>
            <line x1={x0} y1={y0} x2={x1} y2={y1} stroke={c} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round"/>
            {barbs}
        </g>
    )
}

function PalmCrown({ cx, cy, scale = 1 }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx - 30 * scale} y1={cy - 4 * scale} x2={cx - 25 * scale} y2={cy + 4 * scale} side={1} tone="mid"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx + 30 * scale} y1={cy - 4 * scale} x2={cx + 25 * scale} y2={cy + 4 * scale} side={-1} tone="light"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx - 20 * scale} y1={cy - 18 * scale} x2={cx - 14 * scale} y2={cy - 9 * scale} side={1} tone="deep"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx + 20 * scale} y1={cy - 18 * scale} x2={cx + 14 * scale} y2={cy - 9 * scale} side={-1} tone="mid"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx - 14 * scale} y1={cy + 14 * scale} x2={cx - 7 * scale} y2={cy + 7 * scale} side={1} tone="light"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx + 14 * scale} y1={cy + 14 * scale} x2={cx + 7 * scale} y2={cy + 7 * scale} side={-1} tone="deep"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx - 7 * scale} y1={cy - 24 * scale} x2={cx} y2={cy - 13 * scale} side={1} tone="mid"/>
            <PalmLeaf x0={cx} y0={cy} x1={cx + 7 * scale} y1={cy - 24 * scale} x2={cx} y2={cy - 13 * scale} side={-1} tone="light"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function PalmTrunk({ d, segments }) {
    return (
        <g>
            <path d={d} stroke="#8a6b3d" strokeWidth="6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d={d} stroke="#6b4e28" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
            {segments.map((p, i) => (
                <ellipse key={i} cx={p[0]} cy={p[1]} rx={p[2] || 3.2} ry={p[3] || 0.9}
                         fill="#5c4322" opacity="0.9"
                         transform={p[4] ? `rotate(${p[4]} ${p[0]} ${p[1]})` : ''}/>
            ))}
        </g>
    )
}

export function SproutSVG() {
    return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax meet" aria-hidden="true">
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="94" rx="18" ry="3" fill="#b8a06a" opacity="0.85"/>

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/SakuraTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

const PALETTES = {
    light: { petal: '#ffd9e6', petalEdge: '#f9b8d0', core: '#ffe28a', stamen: '#e85a9a' },
    mid:   { petal: '#f9b0cf', petalEdge: '#eb7cae', core: '#ffd068', stamen: '#c93e7d' },
    deep:  { petal: '#ee88b8', petalEdge: '#d3548e', core: '#f4b942', stamen: '#a12c66' },
    pale:  { petal: '#ffe6f0', petalEdge: '#fcc3db', core: '#fff0c0', stamen: '#eb8fbb' },
}

// Один цветок сакуры — крупный, 5 лепестков с выемкой
function SakuraFlower({ cx, cy, r = 6, rot = 0, hue = 'mid' }) {
    const p = PALETTES[hue] || PALETTES.mid
    const petals = []
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const angle = i * 72 + rot
        const rad = angle * Math.PI / 180
        const px = cx + Math.cos(rad) * r * 0.55
        const py = cy + Math.sin(rad) * r * 0.55
        const d = `M${px} ${py - r * 0.55}
                   C${px + r * 0.45} ${py - r * 0.5} ${px + r * 0.55} ${py} ${px} ${py + r * 0.3}
                   C${px - r * 0.55} ${py} ${px - r * 0.45} ${py - r * 0.5} ${px} ${py - r * 0.55} Z`
        petals.push(
            <path key={i} d={d}
                  transform={`rotate(${angle} ${px} ${py})`}
                  fill={p.petal} stroke={p.petalEdge} strokeWidth={r * 0.06} />
        )
    }
    return (
        <g>
            {petals}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 0.18} fill={p.core} />
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={cx - r * 0.35} y2={cy - r * 0.35} stroke={p.stamen} strokeWidth={r * 0.05} opacity="0.75"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={cx + r * 0.35} y2={cy - r * 0.3} stroke={p.stamen} strokeWidth={r * 0.05} opacity="0.75"/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={cx + r * 0.3} y2={cy + r * 0.35} stroke={p.stamen} strokeWidth={r * 0.05} opacity="0.75"/>
        </g>
    )
}

function FlowerCloud({ cx, cy, r = 16, seed = 0, density = 3 }) {
    const flowers = []
    const count = Math.round(density * 8)
    const variants = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'pale', 'light', 'mid']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const dist = r * (0.05 + seededRandom(seed, i + 10) * 0.85)
        const fx = cx + Math.cos(a) * dist
        const fy = cy + Math.sin(a) * dist * 0.85
        flowers.push(
            <SakuraFlower key={i} cx={fx} cy={fy}
                          r={r * 0.35 + seededRandom(seed, i + 20) * r * 0.15}
                          rot={seededRandom(seed, i + 30) * 360}
                          hue={variants[i % variants.length]} />
        )
    }
    return <g>{flowers}</g>
}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/WillowTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

const WILLOW_TONES = {
    light: { fill: '#a8d97b', vein: '#7ab048', edge: '#5c8f3a' },
    mid:   { fill: '#6fb03d', vein: '#4a8a24', edge: '#3f7a2a' },
    deep:  { fill: '#4e8a3a', vein: '#2f6b22', edge: '#255c1a' },
}

// Длинный узкий лист ивы (ланцетовидный)
function WillowLeaf({ cx, cy, size = 4, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const c = WILLOW_TONES[tone] || WILLOW_TONES.mid
    const s = size
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - s * 2.2}
                     C${cx + s * 0.5} ${cy - s * 1.2} ${cx + s * 0.6} ${cy + s * 0.4} ${cx} ${cy + s * 2.2}
                     C${cx - s * 0.6} ${cy + s * 0.4} ${cx - s * 0.5} ${cy - s * 1.2} ${cx} ${cy - s * 2.2} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={s * 0.08}/>
            <line x1={cx} y1={cy - s * 1.8} x2={cx} y2={cy + s * 1.8}
                  stroke={c.vein} strokeWidth={s * 0.08} opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Свисающая ветка — цепочка листьев вдоль ниспадающей линии
function DroopingBranch({ x1, y1, x2, y2, leafCount = 8, seed = 0 }) {
    const items = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'light']

    // Невидимая нить (стебель) — тонкая линия
    items.push(
        <path key="stem" d={`M${x1} ${y1} Q${(x1 + x2) / 2 + (seededRandom(seed, 999) - 0.5) * 4} ${(y1 + y2) / 2} ${x2} ${y2}`}
              stroke="#5c8f3a" strokeWidth="0.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
    )

    // Листья вдоль ветки
    for (let i = 0; i < leafCount; i++) {
        const t = (i + 1) / (leafCount + 1)
        const px = x1 + (x2 - x1) * t
        const py = y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 1.5
        const leafRot = 90 + (seededRandom(seed, i) - 0.5) * 40
        items.push(
            <WillowLeaf key={i} cx={px} cy={py}
                        size={2 + seededRandom(seed, i + 100) * 0.8}
                        rot={leafRot}
                        tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{items}</g>
}

// Кластер — пучок свисающих веток
function WillowCascade({ cx, cy, length = 20, count = 5, seed = 0 }) {
    const branches = []
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const spreadX = (seededRandom(seed, i) - 0.5) * 12
        const len = length * (0.7 + seededRandom(seed, i + 50) * 0.6)
        branches.push(
            <DroopingBranch key={i}
                            x1={cx + spreadX * 0.3} y1={cy}
                            x2={cx + spreadX} y2={cy + len}
                            leafCount={6 + Math.floor(seededRandom(seed, i + 100) * 4)}
                            seed={seed + i * 10}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{branches}</g>
}

// Толстый изогнутый ствол — плакучая форма

                  stroke="#6b5340" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            <path d="M53 76 C52 66 55 58 52 50"
                  stroke="#2f1d14" strokeWidth="1" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
            {/* Кора */}
            <path d="M45 82 C44 76 47 70 49 66" stroke="#2f1d14" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
            <path d="M52 60 C51 54 53 48 51 42" stroke="#2f1d14" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
        </g>
    )
}

            <path d={`M50 ${topY} C52 ${topY - 4} 54 ${topY - 6} 56 ${topY - 8}`} strokeWidth="1.6"/>

}

==================== frontend/src/components/layout/trees/XmasTree.jsx ====================
import { Aura, SparkleRing, seededRandom } from './common'

function Needle({ cx, cy, len = 3, rot = 0, tone = 'mid' }) {
    const palette = {
        light: { fill: '#3d8a3a', edge: '#2a6a28' },
        mid:   { fill: '#1f5e1f', edge: '#134013' },
        deep:  { fill: '#0d3a0d', edge: '#082208' },
    }
    const c = palette[tone] || palette.mid
    return (
        <g transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
            <path d={`M${cx} ${cy - len} L${cx + len * 0.4} ${cy + len * 0.3} L${cx - len * 0.4} ${cy + len * 0.3} Z`}
                  fill={c.fill} stroke={c.edge} strokeWidth={0.2}/>
        </g>
    )
}

function NeedleCluster({ cx, cy, radius = 8, count = 24, seed = 0 }) {
    const needles = []
    const tones = ['light', 'mid', 'deep', 'mid', 'deep']
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = seededRandom(seed, i) * Math.PI * 2
        const d = radius * (0.1 + Math.sqrt(seededRandom(seed, i + 100)) * 1.0)
        const nx = cx + Math.cos(a) * d
        const ny = cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.9
        needles.push(
            <Needle key={i} cx={nx} cy={ny}
                    len={2.2 + seededRandom(seed, i + 200) * 1}
                    rot={(a * 180 / Math.PI) + 180}
                    tone={tones[i % tones.length]}/>
        )
    }
    return <g>{needles}</g>
}

// Шар-игрушка
function Ornament({ cx, cy, r = 2.2, color = '#ff1744', lit = true }) {
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Свечение (если lit) */}
            {lit && (
                <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 2.2} fill={color} opacity="0.25">
                    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.15;0.4;0.15" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
                </circle>
            )}
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill={color}/>
            <circle cx={cx - r * 0.3} cy={cy - r * 0.3} r={r * 0.35} fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
    )
}

// Гирлянда из точек
function Garland({ x1, y1, x2, y2, count = 6, seed = 0, lit = false }) {
    const colors = ['#ff1744', '#ffea00', '#00e676', '#29b6f6', '#ff9100', '#e040fb']
    const dots = []
    for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) {
        const t = i / count
        const cx = x1 + (x2 - x1) * t
        const cy = y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 2
        dots.push(
            <circle key={i} cx={cx} cy={cy} r={lit ? 1 : 0.7}
                    fill={colors[(i + seed) % colors.length]}
                    opacity={lit ? 1 : 0.7}>
                {lit && (
                    <animate attributeName="opacity"
                             values="0.6;1;0.6"
                             dur={`${1.5 + (i % 3) * 0.3}s`}
                             repeatCount="indefinite"/>
                )}
            </circle>
        )
    }
    return <g>{dots}</g>
}

// Звезда
function XmasStar({ cx, cy, r = 4, lit = false }) {
    const points = []
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const a = (i * 36 - 90) * Math.PI / 180
        const rr = i % 2 === 0 ? r : r * 0.45
        points.push(`${cx + Math.cos(a) * rr},${cy + Math.sin(a) * rr}`)
    }
    return (
        <g>
            {/* Свечение вокруг звезды (только когда lit) */}
            {lit && (
                <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 3.5} fill="#ffea00" opacity="0.2">
                    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.1;0.35;0.1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
                </circle>
            )}
            <polygon points={points.join(' ')}
                     fill={lit ? '#ffea00' : '#c9b88a'}
                     stroke={lit ? '#ff8f00' : '#8a7a4a'}
                     strokeWidth="0.4"/>
            <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 0.25}
                    fill={lit ? '#fff59d' : '#e8dca8'}/>
        </g>
    )
}

function XmasTrunk() {
    return (
        <path d="M48 96 L52 96 L51 86 L49 86 Z" fill="#5c3a1e"/>
    )
}

function XmasGround() {
    return (
        <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="96" rx="40" ry="4" fill="#e8e8e8" opacity="0.9"/>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="95" rx="30" ry="2.6" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.95"/>
            <circle cx="20" cy="95" r="0.6" fill="#b3e5fc"/>
            <circle cx="35" cy="96" r="0.5" fill="#b3e5fc"/>
            <circle cx="65" cy="95" r="0.6" fill="#b3e5fc"/>
            <circle cx="80" cy="96" r="0.5" fill="#b3e5fc"/>
        </g>
    )
}
